messages:
sam (sales): Quick heads-up — Acme trial hit streaming session resets through their corp proxy during a demo. Non-streaming calls are fine, streaming dies after ~30s with socket hangup or 502.

jess (solutions): Do they have a forward proxy or SSL-intercepting appliance? Any logs from their side?

sam (sales): They said corporate forward proxy (intercepts TLS). We reproduced with curl behind their proxy; chunked stream appears truncated.

ada (eng): Most likely proxy is closing idle HTTP/1.1 connections or stripping chunked transfer-encoding. What transport is the client using (fetch / websocket / http)?

sam (sales): Node 18 fetch via our TS SDK. Also tried raw curl and saw same behavior.

ada (eng): Two quick mitigation checks: 1) enable keepAlive on the Node https.Agent used by fetch, 2) reduce idle gap between chunks or send small pings. Example agent override: 

```js
import https from 'https';
const agent = new https.Agent({ keepAlive: true, maxSockets: 16, keepAliveMsecs: 20000 });
fetch(url, { agent });
```

ada (eng): In our SDK you can pass an `agent` override or set `CLIENT.requestTimeoutMs`. Also try forcing http/1.1 by setting ALPN/TLS options if the proxy has odd HTTP2 handling.

sam (sales): They can't disable the MITM/TLS interception for the PoC. Mohit — any red flags for guidance we give them?

mohit (security): If their proxy rewrites chunked responses or buffers until complete, streaming will break. We can't ask them to turn off interception, so recommend either: a) use a bridged Dedicated trial inside their network (VPC), or b) switch to short-polling / server-side bridge that re-emits events to clients over WebSocket behind their proxy. I'll prepare wording for the security questionnaire about why interception affects streaming.

jess (solutions): Practically, we can offer a bridging pattern: a small service in their subnet that calls our API (no MITM) and forwards SSE/websocket frames to browsers. It's what we do for regulated customers. I can draft sample code.

jess (solutions): Python snippet for server-side relay (aiohttp streaming reader):

```py
import aiohttp
async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as s:
  async with s.get(api_stream_url, timeout=60) as r:
    async for chunk in r.content.iter_chunked(1024):
      # forward chunk to client websocket or SSE
      ws.send_bytes(chunk)
```

ada (eng): For TS clients, make sure to set retries/backoff and idempotency for non-streaming retries. Streaming doesn't auto-resume — recommend checkpointing tokens on your side and restarting from last known token if client reconnects. Config example for SDK: `retries: 3, backoff: 'exponential', requestTimeoutMs: 60000`.

sam (sales): They also asked about SDK retry behavior semantics and whether we support automatic stream resume. What do we tell them?

ada (eng): We do not resume in-flight streams automatically. For reliable streaming you need: 1) server-side sequence checkpoints, 2) client reconnect logic that requests resume from checkpoint position (application level). For simple demos, non-streaming responses with chunked polling are safer.

sam (sales): Pricing note from customer: will Dedicated trial (30d) include any bridging infra credits or is that billed?

jess (solutions): Sales: we can include a small Dedicated trial credit for PoC bridges — confirm with finance, but it's common to include a measured bridge credit for evaluation. I'll loop in pricing.

mohit (security): Also asked for a short blurb we can include in their security questionnaire about TLS interception: I'll attach a 1-page explanation tomorrow describing how interception affects streaming and mitigation options (bridge, dedicated, short-polling).

deploy-bot: Provisioning note: trial-dedicated-bridge tb-9843 created for acme-trial. Logs will be forwarded to acme-trial-s3 (retention: 7d).

sam (sales): Next steps: jess to send runbook + sample code to customer, ada to add agent override snippet to SDK docs and PR the example, mohit to provide security blurb. I'll schedule a 15:00 PT call with the customer to propose Dedicated trial + bridge.

jess (solutions): On it — will send runbook and short checklist in the next hour. :thumbsup:

ada (eng): Opened docs PR for agent override and streaming notes: https://git.redwood/inference/infra-sdk/pull/482

sam (sales): Thanks everyone — marking as high priority in the POC tracker and will update after the call.
